   100→def build_query_payload(
   101→    queue: Mapping[str, Any],
   102→    items: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]],
   103→    *,
   104→    command: str,
   105→    narrative: Mapping[str, Any] | None,
   106→    plan: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
   107→) -> dict[str, Any]:
   108→    """Build JSON payload for query.json and non-terminal output modes."""
   109→    serialized = [serialize_item(item) for item in items]
   110→    queue_section: dict[str, Any] = {
   111→        "total": queue.get("total", len(items)),
   112→    }
   113→
   114→    payload: dict[str, Any] = {
   115→        "command": command,
   116→        "items": serialized,
   117→        "queue": queue_section,
   118→        "narrative": narrative,
   119→        "agent_notes": [
   120→            "Do NOT use `desloppify plan skip` unless the user explicitly asks you to skip an item.",
   121→            "If you cannot fix an item, report it and move to the next one.",
   122→            "For cluster items: if the autofix_hint finds 0 results, drill into individual issues with the primary_command.",
   123→        ],
   124→    }
   125→
   126→    if plan and (
   127→        plan.get("queue_order")
   128→        or plan.get("skipped")
   129→        or plan.get("clusters")
   130→    ):
   131→        clusters_summary = []
   132→        for name, cluster in plan.get("clusters", {}).items():
   133→            member_ids = set(cluster.get("issue_ids", []))
   134→            clusters_summary.append({
   135→                "name": name,
   136→                "description": cluster.get("description"),
   137→                "item_count": len(member_ids),
   138→            })
   139→        payload["plan"] = {
   140→            "active": True,
   141→            "focus": plan.get("active_cluster"),
   142→            "clusters": clusters_summary,
   143→            "total_ordered": len(plan.get("queue_order", [])),
   144→            "total_skipped": len(plan.get("skipped", {})),
   145→            "plan_overrides_narrative": True,
   146→        }
   147→
   148→    return payload
   149→
   150→
   151→def render_markdown(items: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> str:
   152→    """Render queue items as markdown."""
   153→    lines = [
   154→        "# Desloppify Next Queue",
   155→        "",
   156→        "| Kind | Confidence | Summary | Command |",
   157→        "|------|------------|---------|---------|",
   158→    ]
   159→    for item in items:
   160→        kind = item.get("kind", "issue")
   161→        conf = item.get("confidence", "medium")
   162→        summary = item.get("summary", "").replace("|", "\\|")
   163→        command = (item.get("primary_command", "") or "").replace("|", "\\|")
   164→        lines.append(f"| {kind} | {conf} | {summary} | {command} |")
   165→    lines.append("")
   166→    return "\n".join(lines)
   167→
   168→
   169→def write_output_file(
   170→    output_file: str,
   171→    payload: dict[str, Any],
   172→    item_count: int,
   173→    *,
   174→    safe_write_text_fn,
   175→    colorize_fn,
   176→) -> bool:
   177→    """Persist payload to file and print success/failure hints."""
   178→    try:
   179→        safe_write_text_fn(output_file, json.dumps(payload, indent=2) + "\n")
   180→        print(colorize_fn(f"Wrote {item_count} items to {output_file}", "green"))
   181→    except OSError as exc:
   182→        payload["output_error"] = str(exc)
   183→        print_write_error(output_file, exc, label="next output")
   184→        return False
   185→    return True
   186→
   187→
   188→def emit_non_terminal_output(
   189→    output_format: str,
   190→    payload: dict[str, Any],
   191→    items: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]],
   192→) -> bool:
   193→    """Render JSON/markdown output variants."""
   194→    renderers = {
   195→        "json": lambda: print(json.dumps(payload, indent=2)),
   196→        "md": lambda: print(render_markdown(items)),
   197→    }
   198→    renderer = renderers.get(output_format)
   199→    if renderer is None:
   200→        return False
   201→    renderer()
   202→    return True
   203→
   204→

   207→    "emit_non_terminal_output",
   208→    "render_markdown",

   210→    "write_output_file",
   211→]

    67→def _assessment_provenance_status(
    68→    issues_data: ReviewImportPayload,
    69→    *,

    71→) -> AssessmentProvenanceModel:
    72→    """Evaluate whether assessments come from a trusted blind batch artifact."""

   148→def validate_attested_external_attestation(attest: str | None) -> str | None:
   149→    """Validate and normalize attestation text for attested external imports."""
   150→    if not isinstance(attest, str) or not attest.strip():
   151→        return None
   152→    text = attest.strip()
   153→    lowered = text.lower()
   154→    if all(phrase in lowered for phrase in ATTESTED_EXTERNAL_REQUIRED_PHRASES):
   155→        return text
   156→    return None

   159→def apply_assessment_import_policy(
   160→    issues_data: ReviewImportPayload,
   161→    *,
   162→    import_file: str,
   163→    attested_external: bool,
   164→    attested_attest: str | None,
   165→    manual_override: bool,
   166→    manual_attest: str | None,
   167→    trusted_assessment_source: bool,
   168→    trusted_assessment_label: str | None,
   169→) -> tuple[ReviewImportPayload | None, list[str]]:
   170→    """Apply trust gating for assessment imports (issues import always allowed)."""
   171→    assessments = issues_data["assessments"]
   172→    has_assessments = bool(assessments)
   173→    assessment_count = len(assessments) if has_assessments else 0
   174→    provenance_status = _assessment_provenance_status(
   175→        issues_data, import_file=import_file
   176→    )
   177→    policy = AssessmentImportPolicyModel(
   178→        assessments_present=has_assessments,
   179→        assessment_count=int(assessment_count),
   180→        trusted=False,
   181→        mode="none",
   182→        reason="",
   183→        provenance=provenance_status,
   184→    )
   185→
   186→    if not has_assessments:
   187→        return _attach_assessment_policy(issues_data, policy), []
   188→
   189→    if trusted_assessment_source:
   190→        trusted_policy = replace(
   191→            policy,
   192→            mode="trusted_internal",
   193→            trusted=True,
   194→            reason=(trusted_assessment_label or "trusted internal run-batches import"),
   195→        )
   196→        return _attach_assessment_policy(issues_data, trusted_policy), []
   197→
   198→    if attested_external:
   199→        return _apply_attested_external_policy(
   200→            issues_data,
   201→            policy=policy,
   202→            provenance_status=provenance_status,
   203→            attested_attest=attested_attest,
   204→        )
   205→
   206→    if manual_override:
   207→        return _apply_manual_override_policy(
   208→            issues_data,
   209→            policy=policy,
   210→            manual_attest=manual_attest,
   211→        )
   212→
   213→    return _apply_issues_only_policy(
   214→        issues_data,
   215→        policy=policy,
   216→        provenance_status=provenance_status,
   217→    )

   220→def _attach_assessment_policy(
   221→    payload: ReviewImportPayload,
   222→    policy: AssessmentImportPolicyModel,
   223→) -> ReviewImportPayload:
   224→    normalized = dict(payload)
   225→    normalized[ASSESSMENT_POLICY_KEY] = policy.to_dict()
   226→    return normalized
   227→
   228→
   229→def _apply_attested_external_policy(
   230→    issues_data: ReviewImportPayload,
   231→    *,
   232→    policy: AssessmentImportPolicyModel,
   233→    provenance_status: AssessmentProvenanceModel,
   234→    attested_attest: str | None,
   235→) -> tuple[ReviewImportPayload | None, list[str]]:
   236→    normalized_attest = validate_attested_external_attestation(attested_attest)
   237→    if normalized_attest is None:
   238→        return None, [
   239→            "--attested-external requires --attest containing both "
   240→            "'without awareness' and 'unbiased'"
   241→        ]
   242→    if provenance_status.trusted is not True:
   243→        return None, [
   244→            "--attested-external requires valid blind packet provenance "
   245→            f"(current status: {provenance_status.reason or 'untrusted provenance'})"
   246→        ]
   247→    runner = provenance_status.runner.strip().lower()
   248→    if runner not in ATTESTED_EXTERNAL_RUNNERS:
   249→        return None, [
   250→            "--attested-external currently supports runner='claude' provenance only"
   251→        ]
   252→    attested_policy = replace(
   253→        policy,
   254→        mode="attested_external",
   255→        trusted=True,
   256→        reason="attested external blind subagent provenance",
   257→        attest=normalized_attest,
   258→    )
   259→    return _attach_assessment_policy(issues_data, attested_policy), []
   260→
   261→
   262→def _apply_manual_override_policy(
   263→    issues_data: ReviewImportPayload,
   264→    *,
   265→    policy: AssessmentImportPolicyModel,
   266→    manual_attest: str | None,
   267→) -> tuple[ReviewImportPayload | None, list[str]]:
   268→    if not isinstance(manual_attest, str) or not manual_attest.strip():
   269→        return None, ["--manual-override requires --attest"]
   270→    override_policy = replace(
   271→        policy,
   272→        mode="manual_override",
   273→        reason="manual override attested by operator",
   274→        attest=manual_attest.strip(),
   275→    )
   276→    return _attach_assessment_policy(issues_data, override_policy), []
   277→
   278→
   279→def _issues_only_reason(
   280→    issues_data: ReviewImportPayload,
   281→    *,
   282→    provenance_status: AssessmentProvenanceModel,
   283→) -> str:
   284→    if not issues_data["provenance"]:
   285→        return "missing trusted run-batches source; imported issues only"
   286→    provenance_reason = provenance_status.reason.strip()
   287→    if provenance_status.trusted is True:
   288→        return (
   289→            "external imports cannot self-attest trust even when provenance appears valid; "
   290→            "run review --run-batches to apply assessments automatically"
   291→        )
   292→    if provenance_reason:
   293→        return (
   294→            "external imports cannot self-attest trust "
   295→            f"({provenance_reason}); run review --run-batches to apply assessments automatically"
   296→        )
   297→    return (
   298→        "external imports cannot self-attest trust; "
   299→        "run review --run-batches to apply assessments automatically"
   300→    )
   301→
   302→
   303→def _apply_issues_only_policy(
   304→    issues_data: ReviewImportPayload,
   305→    *,
   306→    policy: AssessmentImportPolicyModel,
   307→    provenance_status: AssessmentProvenanceModel,
   308→) -> tuple[ReviewImportPayload, list[str]]:
   309→    issues_only_policy = replace(
   310→        policy,
   311→        mode="issues_only",
   312→        reason=_issues_only_reason(issues_data, provenance_status=provenance_status),
   313→    )
   314→    payload = dict(issues_data)
   315→    payload["assessments"] = {}
   316→    payload[ASSESSMENT_POLICY_KEY] = issues_only_policy.to_dict()
   317→    return payload, []
   318→
   319→
   320→def assessment_policy_from_payload(payload: ReviewImportPayload) -> AssessmentImportPolicy:
   321→    """Return parsed assessment policy metadata from a loaded import payload."""
   322→    policy = payload[ASSESSMENT_POLICY_KEY]
   323→    if isinstance(policy, dict):
   324→        return policy
   325→    return AssessmentImportPolicyModel().to_dict()
   326→
   327→
   328→def assessment_policy_model_from_payload(
   329→    payload: ReviewImportPayload,
   330→) -> AssessmentImportPolicyModel:
   331→    """Return typed assessment policy metadata from a loaded import payload."""
   332→    return AssessmentImportPolicyModel.from_mapping(assessment_policy_from_payload(payload))
   333→

   335→def assessment_mode_label(policy: AssessmentImportPolicy) -> str:
   336→    """Return a user-facing label for the selected assessment import mode."""
   337→    mode = AssessmentImportPolicyModel.from_mapping(policy).mode.strip().lower()
   338→    return ASSESSMENT_MODE_LABELS.get(mode, f"unknown ({mode or 'none'})")

1→"""Python language security + coverage wiring helpers."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→import shutil
     6→
     7→from desloppify.base.discovery.source import collect_exclude_dirs
     8→from desloppify.languages._framework.base.types import DetectorCoverageStatus, LangSecurityResult

    10→from desloppify.languages.python._helpers import scan_root_from_files
    11→
    12→
    13→def missing_bandit_coverage() -> DetectorCoverageStatus:
    14→    return DetectorCoverageStatus(
    15→        detector="security",
    16→        status="reduced",
    17→        confidence=0.6,
    18→        summary="bandit is not installed — Python-specific security checks will be skipped.",
    19→        impact=(
    20→            "Python-specific security coverage is reduced; clean security output may "
    21→            "miss shell injection, unsafe deserialization, and risky SQL/subprocess patterns."
    22→        ),
    23→        remediation="Install Bandit: pip install bandit",
    24→        tool="bandit",
    25→        reason="missing_dependency",
    26→    )
    27→
    28→
    29→def python_scan_coverage_prerequisites() -> list[DetectorCoverageStatus]:
    30→    if shutil.which("bandit") is not None:
    31→        return []
    32→    return [missing_bandit_coverage()]
    33→
    34→
    35→def detect_python_security(files, zone_map) -> LangSecurityResult:
    36→    scan_root = scan_root_from_files(files)
    37→    if scan_root is None:
    38→        return LangSecurityResult(entries=[], files_scanned=0)
    39→
    40→    exclude_dirs = collect_exclude_dirs(scan_root)
    41→    result = detect_with_bandit(scan_root, zone_map, exclude_dirs=exclude_dirs)
    42→    coverage = result.status.coverage()
    43→    return LangSecurityResult(
    44→        entries=result.entries,
    45→        files_scanned=result.files_scanned,
    46→        coverage=coverage,
    47→    )
    48→
    49→
    50→__all__ = [
    51→    "detect_python_security",
    52→    "missing_bandit_coverage",
    53→    "python_scan_coverage_prerequisites",
    54→]

   317→def utc_now() -> str:
   318→    """Return current UTC timestamp with second-level precision."""
   319→    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(timespec="seconds")
   320→
   321→
   322→def empty_state() -> StateModel:
   323→    """Return a new empty state payload."""
   324→    return {
   325→        "version": CURRENT_VERSION,
   326→        "created": utc_now(),
   327→        "last_scan": None,
   328→        "scan_count": 0,
   329→        "overall_score": 0,
   330→        "objective_score": 0,
   331→        "strict_score": 0,
   332→        "verified_strict_score": 0,
   333→        "stats": {},
   334→        "issues": {},
   335→        "scan_coverage": {},
   336→        "score_confidence": {},
   337→        "subjective_integrity": {},
   338→        "subjective_assessments": {},
   339→    }
   340→
   341→
   342→def _as_non_negative_int(value: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
   343→    try:
   344→        parsed = int(value)
   345→    except (TypeError, ValueError):
   346→        return default
   347→    return parsed if parsed >= 0 else 0
   348→
   349→
   350→def _rename_key(d: dict, old: str, new: str) -> bool:
   351→    if old not in d:
   352→        return False
   353→    d.setdefault(new, d.pop(old))
   354→    return True
   355→
   356→
   357→def migrate_state_keys(state: StateModel | dict[str, Any]) -> None:
   358→    """Migrate legacy key names in-place.
   359→
   360→    - ``"findings"`` → ``"issues"``
   361→    - ``dimension_scores[dim]["issues"]`` → ``"failing"``
   362→    """
   363→    state_dict = cast(dict[str, Any], state)
   364→    _rename_key(state_dict, "findings", "issues")
   365→
   366→    for ds in state_dict.get("dimension_scores", {}).values():
   367→        if isinstance(ds, dict):
   368→            _rename_key(ds, "issues", "failing")
   369→
   370→    for entry in state_dict.get("scan_history", []):
   371→        if not isinstance(entry, dict):
   372→            continue
   373→        _rename_key(entry, "raw_findings", "raw_issues")
   374→        for ds in (entry.get("dimension_scores") or {}).values():
   375→            if isinstance(ds, dict):
   376→                _rename_key(ds, "issues", "failing")
   377→
   378→
   379→def ensure_state_defaults(state: StateModel | dict) -> None:
   380→    """Normalize loose/legacy state payloads to a valid base shape in-place."""
   381→    migrate_state_keys(state)
   382→
   383→    mutable_state = cast(dict[str, Any], state)
   384→    for key, value in empty_state().items():
   385→        mutable_state.setdefault(key, value)
   386→
   387→    if not isinstance(state.get("issues"), dict):
   388→        state["issues"] = {}
   389→    if not isinstance(state.get("stats"), dict):
   390→        state["stats"] = {}
   391→    if not isinstance(state.get("scan_history"), list):
   392→        state["scan_history"] = []
   393→    if not isinstance(state.get("scan_coverage"), dict):
   394→        state["scan_coverage"] = {}
   395→    if not isinstance(state.get("score_confidence"), dict):
   396→        state["score_confidence"] = {}
   397→    if not isinstance(state.get("subjective_integrity"), dict):
   398→        state["subjective_integrity"] = {}
   399→
   400→    all_issues = state["issues"]
   401→    to_remove: list[str] = []
   402→    for issue_id, issue in all_issues.items():
   403→        if not isinstance(issue, dict):
   404→            to_remove.append(issue_id)
   405→            continue
   406→
   407→        issue.setdefault("id", issue_id)
   408→        issue.setdefault("detector", "unknown")
   409→        issue.setdefault("file", "")
   410→        issue.setdefault("tier", 3)
   411→        issue.setdefault("confidence", "low")
   412→        issue.setdefault("summary", "")
   413→        issue.setdefault("detail", {})
   414→        issue.setdefault("status", "open")
   415→        issue["status"] = canonical_issue_status(
   416→            issue.get("status"),
   417→            default="open",
   418→        )
   419→        issue.setdefault("note", None)
   420→        issue.setdefault("first_seen", state.get("created") or utc_now())
   421→        issue.setdefault("last_seen", issue["first_seen"])
   422→        issue.setdefault("resolved_at", None)
   423→        issue["reopen_count"] = _as_non_negative_int(
   424→            issue.get("reopen_count", 0), default=0
   425→        )
   426→        issue.setdefault("suppressed", False)
   427→        issue.setdefault("suppressed_at", None)
   428→        issue.setdefault("suppression_pattern", None)
   429→
   430→    for issue_id in to_remove:
   431→        all_issues.pop(issue_id, None)
   432→
   433→    for entry in state["scan_history"]:
   434→        if not isinstance(entry, dict):
   435→            continue
   436→        integrity = entry.get("subjective_integrity")
   437→        if integrity is not None and not isinstance(integrity, dict):
   438→            entry["subjective_integrity"] = None
   439→
   440→    state["scan_count"] = _as_non_negative_int(state.get("scan_count", 0), default=0)
   441→    return None
   442→
   443→
   444→def validate_state_invariants(state: StateModel) -> None:
   445→    """Raise ValueError when core state invariants are violated."""
   446→    if not isinstance(state.get("issues"), dict):
   447→        raise ValueError("state.issues must be a dict")
   448→    if not isinstance(state.get("stats"), dict):
   449→        raise ValueError("state.stats must be a dict")
   450→
   451→    all_issues = state["issues"]
   452→    for issue_id, issue in all_issues.items():
   453→        if not isinstance(issue, dict):
   454→            raise ValueError(f"issue {issue_id!r} must be a dict")
   455→        if issue.get("id") != issue_id:
   456→            raise ValueError(f"issue id mismatch for {issue_id!r}")
   457→        if issue.get("status") not in _ALLOWED_ISSUE_STATUSES:
   458→            raise ValueError(
   459→                f"issue {issue_id!r} has invalid status {issue.get('status')!r}"
   460→            )
   461→
   462→        tier = issue.get("tier")
   463→        if not isinstance(tier, int) or tier < 1 or tier > 4:
   464→            raise ValueError(f"issue {issue_id!r} has invalid tier {tier!r}")
   465→
   466→        reopen_count = issue.get("reopen_count")
   467→        if not isinstance(reopen_count, int) or reopen_count < 0:
   468→            raise ValueError(
   469→                f"issue {issue_id!r} has invalid reopen_count {reopen_count!r}"
   470→            )
   471→

1→"""Shared helpers for scan command orchestration."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→import logging
     6→from pathlib import Path
     7→
     8→from desloppify import languages as lang_api
     9→from desloppify import state as state_mod
    10→from desloppify.base.discovery.source import (
    11→    DEFAULT_EXCLUSIONS,
    12→    read_file_text,
    13→)
    14→from desloppify.base.discovery.file_paths import count_lines
    15→from desloppify.base.output.terminal import colorize
    16→
    17→logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
    18→
    19→
    20→def audit_excluded_dirs(
    21→    exclusions: tuple[str, ...],
    22→    scanned_files: list[str],
    23→    project_root: Path,
    24→) -> list[dict]:
    25→    """Check if any --exclude directory has zero references from scanned code.
    26→
    27→    Returns issues for directories that appear stale (no file references them).
    28→    """
    29→    if not exclusions:
    30→        return []
    31→
    32→    candidate_dirs = [
    33→        ex_dir
    34→        for ex_dir in exclusions
    35→        if ex_dir not in DEFAULT_EXCLUSIONS and (project_root / ex_dir).is_dir()
    36→    ]
    37→    if not candidate_dirs:
    38→        return []
    39→
    40→    # Read each scanned file once and mark any exclusions observed in content.
    41→    unresolved = set(candidate_dirs)
    42→    for filepath in scanned_files:
    43→        if not unresolved:
    44→            break
    45→        abs_path = (
    46→            filepath if Path(filepath).is_absolute() else str(project_root / filepath)
    47→        )
    48→        content = read_file_text(abs_path)
    49→        if content is None:
    50→            logger.debug(
    51→                "Skipping unreadable file %s while auditing exclusions", filepath
    52→            )
    53→            continue
    54→
    55→        matched = {ex_dir for ex_dir in unresolved if ex_dir in content}
    56→        if matched:
    57→            unresolved.difference_update(matched)
    58→
    59→    stale_issues = []
    60→    for ex_dir in candidate_dirs:
    61→        if ex_dir not in unresolved:
    62→            continue
    63→        stale_issues.append(
    64→            state_mod.make_issue(
    65→                "stale_exclude",
    66→                ex_dir,
    67→                ex_dir,
    68→                tier=4,
    69→                confidence="low",
    70→                summary=(
    71→                    f"Excluded directory '{ex_dir}' has 0 references from scanned code — "
    72→                    "may be stale"
    73→                ),
    74→                detail={"directory": ex_dir, "references": 0},
    75→            )
    76→        )
    77→    return stale_issues
    78→
    79→
    80→def collect_codebase_metrics(lang, path: Path) -> dict | None:
    81→    """Collect LOC/file/directory counts for the configured language."""
    82→    if not lang or not lang.file_finder:
    83→        return None
    84→    files = lang.file_finder(path)
    85→    total_loc = 0
    86→    dirs = set()
    87→    for filepath in files:
    88→        try:
    89→            total_loc += count_lines(Path(filepath))
    90→            dirs.add(str(Path(filepath).parent))
    91→        except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError) as exc:
    92→            logger.debug(
    93→                "Skipping unreadable file %s while collecting scan metrics: %s",
    94→                filepath,
    95→                exc,
    96→            )
    97→    return {
    98→        "total_files": len(files),
    99→        "total_loc": total_loc,
   100→        "total_directories": len(dirs),
   101→    }
   102→
   103→
   104→def resolve_scan_profile(profile: str | None, lang) -> str:
   105→    """Resolve effective scan profile from CLI and language defaults."""
   106→    if profile in {"objective", "full", "ci"}:
   107→        return profile
   108→    default_profile = getattr(lang, "default_scan_profile", "full") if lang else "full"
   109→    if default_profile in {"objective", "full", "ci"}:
   110→        return default_profile
   111→    return "full"
   112→
   113→
   114→def effective_include_slow(include_slow: bool, profile: str) -> bool:
   115→    """Determine whether slow phases should run for this profile."""
   116→    return include_slow and profile != "ci"
   117→
   118→
   119→def _format_hidden_by_detector(hidden_by_detector: dict[str, int]) -> str:
   120→    """Format hidden issues counts for terminal output."""
   121→    return ", ".join(f"{det}: +{count}" for det, count in hidden_by_detector.items())
   122→
   123→
   124→def warn_explicit_lang_with_no_files(
   125→    args, lang, path: Path, metrics: dict | None
   126→) -> None:
   127→    """Warn when user explicitly selected a language but scan found zero files."""
   128→    explicit_lang = getattr(args, "lang", None)
   129→    if not explicit_lang or not lang or not metrics:
   130→        return
   131→    if metrics.get("total_files", 0) > 0:
   132→        return
   133→
   134→    suggestion = " Omit `--lang` to auto-detect."
   135→    root = path if path.is_dir() else path.parent
   136→    try:
   137→        detected = lang_api.auto_detect_lang(root)
   138→    except ValueError as exc:
   139→        detected = None
   140→        logger.debug(
   141→            "Auto-detect failed while warning for explicit lang on %s: %s", root, exc
   142→        )
   143→    else:
   144→        if detected and detected != lang.name:
   145→            suggestion = (
   146→                f" Detected `{detected}` for this path — use `--lang {detected}` "
   147→                "or omit `--lang`."
   148→            )
   149→
   150→    print(
   151→        colorize(
   152→            f"  ⚠ No {lang.name} source files found under `{path}`.{suggestion}",
   153→            "yellow",
   154→        )
   155→    )
   156→
   157→
   158→def format_delta(value: float, prev: float | None) -> tuple[str, str]:
   159→    """Return (delta_str, color) for a score change."""
   160→    delta = value - prev if prev is not None else 0
   161→    delta_str = f" ({'+' if delta > 0 else ''}{delta:.1f})" if delta != 0 else ""
   162→    color = "green" if delta > 0 else ("red" if delta < 0 else "dim")
   163→    return delta_str, color
   164→

   171→    "_format_hidden_by_detector",
   172→    "resolve_scan_profile",
   173→    "warn_explicit_lang_with_no_files",
   174→]

   207→    any cached scoring artifacts (integrity_penalty, components,
   208→    component_scores) plus provisional-override markers.

   210→    payload["score"] = 0.0
   211→    payload["source"] = source
   212→    payload["assessed_at"] = now
   213→    payload["reset_by"] = source
   214→    payload["placeholder"] = True
   215→    payload.pop("integrity_penalty", None)

   217→    payload.pop("component_scores", None)
   218→    payload.pop("provisional_override", None)

   238→    source = "scan_reset_subjective"

   240→        payload = assessments.get(key)
   241→        if isinstance(payload, dict):
   242→            _apply_assessment_reset(payload, source=source, now=now)
   243→            continue
   244→        assessments[key] = {
   245→            "score": 0.0,
   246→            "source": source,
   247→            "assessed_at": now,
   248→            "reset_by": source,
   249→            "placeholder": True,
   250→        }
   251→    return len(reset_keys)

   313→    zone_overrides = zone_overrides_raw if isinstance(zone_overrides_raw, dict) else None
   314→
   315→    return ScanRuntime(
   316→        args=args,
   317→        state_path=state_file,
   318→        state=state,
   319→        path=path,
   320→        config=config,
   321→        lang=lang,
   322→        lang_label=f" ({lang.name})" if lang else "",
   323→        profile=profile,
   324→        effective_include_slow=include_slow_effective,
   325→        zone_overrides=zone_overrides,
   326→        reset_subjective_count=reset_subjective_count,
   327→        expired_manual_override_count=expired_manual_override_count,
   328→        coverage_warnings=coverage_warnings,
   329→    )
   330→
   331→
   332→def _augment_with_stale_exclusion_issues(
   333→    issues: list[dict[str, Any]],
   334→    runtime: ScanRuntime,
   335→) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
   336→    """Append stale exclude issues when excluded dirs are unreferenced."""
   337→    extra_exclusions = get_exclusions()
   338→    if not (extra_exclusions and runtime.lang and runtime.lang.file_finder):
   339→        return issues
   340→
   341→    scanned_files = runtime.lang.file_finder(runtime.path)
   342→    stale = audit_excluded_dirs(
   343→        extra_exclusions, scanned_files, get_project_root()
   344→    )
   345→    if not stale:
   346→        return issues
   347→
   348→    augmented = list(issues)
   349→    augmented.extend(stale)
   350→    for stale_issue in stale:
   351→        print(colorize(f"  ℹ {stale_issue['summary']}", "dim"))
   352→    return augmented
   353→
   354→
   355→def _augment_with_stale_wontfix_issues(
   356→    issues: list[dict[str, Any]],
   357→    runtime: ScanRuntime,
   358→    *,
   359→    decay_scans: int,
   360→) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], int]:
   361→    """Append re-triage issues for stale/worsening wontfix debt."""
   362→    return _augment_stale_wontfix_impl(
   363→        issues,
   364→        state=runtime.state,
   365→        scan_path=runtime.path,
   366→        project_root=get_project_root(),
   367→        decay_scans=decay_scans,
   368→    )
   369→
   370→
   371→def run_scan_generation(
   372→    runtime: ScanRuntime,
   373→) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, object], dict[str, object] | None]:
   374→    """Run detector pipeline and return issues, potentials, and codebase metrics."""
   375→    enable_file_cache()
   376→    enable_parse_cache()
   377→    try:
   378→        issues, potentials = plan_mod.generate_issues(
   379→            runtime.path,
   380→            lang=runtime.lang,
   381→            options=PlanScanOptions(
   382→                include_slow=runtime.effective_include_slow,
   383→                zone_overrides=runtime.zone_overrides,
   384→                profile=runtime.profile,
   385→            ),
   386→        )
   387→    finally:
   388→        disable_parse_cache()
   389→        disable_file_cache()
   390→
   391→    codebase_metrics = collect_codebase_metrics(runtime.lang, runtime.path)
   392→    warn_explicit_lang_with_no_files(
   393→        runtime.args, runtime.lang, runtime.path, codebase_metrics
   394→    )
   395→    issues = _augment_with_stale_exclusion_issues(issues, runtime)
   396→    decay_scans = _coerce_int(
   397→        runtime.config.get("wontfix_decay_scans"),
   398→        default=_WONTFIX_DECAY_SCANS_DEFAULT,
   399→    )
   400→    issues, monitored_wontfix = _augment_with_stale_wontfix_issues(
   401→        issues,
   402→        runtime,
   403→        decay_scans=max(decay_scans, 0),
   404→    )
   405→    potentials["stale_wontfix"] = monitored_wontfix
   406→    return issues, potentials, codebase_metrics
   407→
   408→
   409→def merge_scan_results(
   410→    runtime: ScanRuntime,
   411→    issues: list[dict[str, Any]],
   412→    potentials: dict[str, object],
   413→    codebase_metrics: dict[str, object] | None,
   414→) -> ScanMergeResult:
   415→    """Merge issues into persistent state and return diff + previous score snapshot."""
   416→    scan_path_rel = rel(str(runtime.path))
   417→    prev_scan_path = runtime.state.get("scan_path")
   418→    path_changed = prev_scan_path is not None and prev_scan_path != scan_path_rel
   419→
   420→    if not path_changed:
   421→        prev = state_mod.score_snapshot(runtime.state)
   422→    else:
   423→        prev = state_mod.ScoreSnapshot(None, None, None, None)
   424→    prev_dim_scores = (
   425→        runtime.state.get("dimension_scores", {}) if not path_changed else {}
   426→    )
   427→
   428→    if runtime.lang and runtime.lang.zone_map is not None:
   429→        runtime.state["zone_distribution"] = runtime.lang.zone_map.counts()
   430→    _persist_scan_coverage(runtime.state, runtime.lang)
   431→
   432→    target_score = target_strict_score_from_config(runtime.config)
   433→
   434→    diff = state_mod.merge_scan(
   435→        runtime.state,
   436→        issues,
   437→        options=state_mod.MergeScanOptions(
   438→            lang=runtime.lang.name if runtime.lang else None,
   439→            scan_path=scan_path_rel,
   440→            force_resolve=getattr(runtime.args, "force_resolve", False),
   441→            exclude=get_exclusions(),
   442→            potentials=potentials,
   443→            codebase_metrics=codebase_metrics,
   444→            include_slow=runtime.effective_include_slow,
   445→            ignore=runtime.config.get("ignore", []),
   446→            subjective_integrity_target=target_score,
   447→        ),
   448→    )
   449→
   450→    expire_stale_holistic(
   451→        runtime.state, runtime.config.get("holistic_max_age_days", 30)
   452→    )
   453→    state_mod.save_state(
   454→        runtime.state,
   455→        runtime.state_path,
   456→        subjective_integrity_target=target_score,
   457→    )
   458→
   459→    _clear_needs_rescan_flag(runtime.config)
   460→    _reconcile_plan_post_scan(runtime)
   461→
   462→    return ScanMergeResult(
   463→        diff=diff,
   464→        prev_overall=prev.overall,
   465→        prev_objective=prev.objective,
   466→        prev_strict=prev.strict,
   467→        prev_verified=prev.verified,
   468→        prev_dim_scores=prev_dim_scores,
   469→    )
   470→
   471→
   472→def resolve_noise_snapshot(
   473→    state: state_mod.StateModel,
   474→    config: dict[str, object],
   475→) -> ScanNoiseSnapshot:
   476→    """Resolve noise budget settings and hidden issue counters."""
   477→    noise_budget, global_noise_budget, budget_warning = (
   478→        state_mod.resolve_issue_noise_settings(config)
   479→    )
   480→    issues_by_id = _state_issues(state)
   481→    open_issues = [
   482→        issue
   483→        for issue in state_mod.path_scoped_issues(
   484→            issues_by_id, state.get("scan_path")
   485→        ).values()
   486→        if issue.get("status") == "open"
   487→    ]
   488→    _, hidden_by_detector = state_mod.apply_issue_noise_budget(
   489→        open_issues,
   490→        budget=noise_budget,
   491→        global_budget=global_noise_budget,
   492→    )
   493→
   494→    return ScanNoiseSnapshot(
   495→        noise_budget=noise_budget,
   496→        global_noise_budget=global_noise_budget,
   497→        budget_warning=budget_warning,
   498→        hidden_by_detector=hidden_by_detector,
   499→        hidden_total=sum(hidden_by_detector.values()),
   500→    )
   501→
   502→
   503→def persist_reminder_history(
   504→    runtime: ScanRuntime,
   505→    narrative: dict[str, object],
   506→) -> None:
   507→    """Persist reminder history emitted by narrative computation."""
   508→    if not (narrative and "reminder_history" in narrative):
   509→        return
   510→
   511→    runtime.state["reminder_history"] = narrative["reminder_history"]
   512→    target_score = target_strict_score_from_config(runtime.config)
   513→    state_mod.save_state(
   514→        runtime.state,
   515→        runtime.state_path,
   516→        subjective_integrity_target=target_score,
   517→    )
   518→
   519→
   520→__all__ = [
   521→    "ScanStateContractError",

   527→    "prepare_scan_runtime",
   528→    "resolve_noise_snapshot",
   529→    "run_scan_generation",
   530→]

    11→
    12→def add_uncommitted_issues(plan: dict[str, Any], issue_ids: list[str]) -> int:
    13→    """Add issue IDs to the uncommitted list (deduplicates).  Returns count added."""
    14→    uncommitted: list[str] = plan.setdefault("uncommitted_issues", [])
    15→    existing = set(uncommitted)
    16→    added = 0
    17→    for fid in issue_ids:
    18→        if fid not in existing:
    19→            uncommitted.append(fid)
    20→            existing.add(fid)
    21→            added += 1
    22→    return added
    23→
    24→
    25→def purge_uncommitted_ids(plan: dict[str, Any], issue_ids: list[str]) -> int:
    26→    """Remove issue IDs from the uncommitted list.  Returns count removed."""
    27→    to_remove = set(issue_ids)
    28→    uncommitted: list[str] = plan.get("uncommitted_issues", [])
    29→    original = len(uncommitted)
    30→    plan["uncommitted_issues"] = [fid for fid in uncommitted if fid not in to_remove]
    31→    return original - len(plan["uncommitted_issues"])
    32→
    33→
    34→def get_uncommitted_issues(plan: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
    35→    """Return the current uncommitted issue IDs."""
    36→    return list(plan.get("uncommitted_issues", []))
    37→
    38→
    39→def record_commit(
    40→    plan: dict[str, Any],
    41→    sha: str,
    42→    branch: str | None = None,
    43→    issue_ids: list[str] | None = None,
    44→    note: str | None = None,
    45→    cluster_name: str | None = None,
    46→) -> CommitRecord:
    47→    """Move uncommitted issues into a new CommitRecord.
    48→
    49→    If *issue_ids* is None, all uncommitted issues are recorded.
    50→    """
    51→    uncommitted = plan.get("uncommitted_issues", [])
    52→    if issue_ids is None:
    53→        ids_to_record = list(uncommitted)
    54→    else:
    55→        ids_to_record = list(issue_ids)
    56→
    57→    record: CommitRecord = {
    58→        "sha": sha,
    59→        "branch": branch,
    60→        "issue_ids": ids_to_record,
    61→        "recorded_at": utc_now(),
    62→        "note": note,
    63→        "cluster_name": cluster_name,
    64→    }
    65→
    66→    commit_log: list[CommitRecord] = plan.setdefault("commit_log", [])
    67→    commit_log.append(record)
    68→
    69→    # Remove recorded IDs from uncommitted
    70→    recorded_set = set(ids_to_record)
    71→    plan["uncommitted_issues"] = [fid for fid in uncommitted if fid not in recorded_set]
    72→
    73→    return record
    74→
    75→
    76→def find_commit_for_issue(plan: dict[str, Any], issue_id: str) -> CommitRecord | None:
    77→    """Find the CommitRecord that contains a given issue ID."""
    78→    for record in plan.get("commit_log", []):
    79→        if issue_id in record.get("issue_ids", []):
    80→            return record

    24→    def write_best_effort(self, data: dict, *, context: str) -> OutputResult:

    35→        return result

   316→def cmd_plan_unskip(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
   317→    """Unskip issues — bring back to queue."""
   318→    runtime = command_runtime(args)
   319→    state = runtime.state
   320→    if not require_completed_scan(state):

   322→
   323→    patterns: list[str] = getattr(args, "patterns", [])
   324→
   325→    state_file = runtime.state_path
   326→    plan_file = _plan_file_for_state(state_file)

   328→    # For unskip we need to match against all statuses (skipped items may be wontfix/fp)
   329→    issue_ids = resolve_ids_from_patterns(state, patterns, plan=plan, status_filter="all")
   330→    if not issue_ids:

   333→
   334→    include_protected = bool(getattr(args, "force", False))
   335→    count, need_reopen, protected_kept = unskip_items(
   336→        plan, issue_ids, include_protected=include_protected,
   337→    )
   338→    unskipped_ids = [fid for fid in issue_ids if fid not in protected_kept]
   339→    append_log_entry(
   340→        plan, "unskip", issue_ids=unskipped_ids, actor="user",
   341→        detail={"need_reopen": need_reopen},
   342→    )
   343→
   344→    # Reopen permanent/false_positive items in state
   345→    reopened: list[str] = []
   346→    if need_reopen:
   347→        state_data = state_mod.load_state(state_file)
   348→        for fid in need_reopen:
   349→            reopened.extend(state_mod.resolve_issues(state_data, fid, "open"))
   350→        _save_plan_state_transactional(

   353→            state_data=state_data,
   354→            state_path_value=state_file,

   356→        print(colorize(f"  Reopened {len(reopened)} issue(s) in state.", "dim"))
   357→    else:
   358→        save_plan(plan, plan_file)

   373→def cmd_plan_reopen(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
   374→    """Reopen resolved issues from plan context."""
   375→    patterns: list[str] = getattr(args, "patterns", [])
   376→
   377→    raw_state_path = state_path(args)
   378→    state_file = raw_state_path if isinstance(raw_state_path, Path) else Path(raw_state_path) if raw_state_path else None
   379→    state_data = state_mod.load_state(state_file)
   380→    plan_file = _plan_file_for_state(state_file)
   381→
   382→    reopened: list[str] = []
   383→    for pattern in patterns:
   384→        reopened.extend(
   385→            state_mod.resolve_issues(state_data, pattern, "open")
   386→        )
   387→
   388→    if not reopened:
   389→        print(colorize("  No resolved issues matching: " + " ".join(patterns), "yellow"))
   390→        return
   391→
   392→    # Remove from skipped if present, and ensure all reopened IDs are in queue
   393→    plan = load_plan(plan_file)
   394→
   395→    # Remove from commit tracking uncommitted list
   396→    purge_uncommitted_ids(plan, reopened)
   397→
   398→    skipped = plan.get("skipped", {})
   399→    count = 0
   400→    order = set(plan.get("queue_order", []))
   401→    for fid in reopened:
   402→        if fid in skipped:
   403→            skipped.pop(fid)
   404→            count += 1
   405→        if fid not in order:
   406→            plan["queue_order"].append(fid)
   407→            order.add(fid)
   408→            count += 1
   409→    append_log_entry(
   410→        plan, "reopen", issue_ids=reopened, actor="user",
   411→    )
   412→    _save_plan_state_transactional(
   413→        plan=plan,
   414→        plan_path=plan_file,
   415→        state_data=state_data,
   416→        state_path_value=state_file,
   417→    )
   418→
   419→    print(colorize(f"  Reopened {len(reopened)} issue(s).", "green"))
   420→    if count:
   421→        print(colorize("  Plan updated: items moved back to queue.", "dim"))

   427→def _check_cluster_guard(patterns: list[str], plan: dict, state: dict) -> bool:
   428→    """Return True if blocked by cluster guard, False if OK to proceed."""
   429→    clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
   430→    issues = state.get("issues", {})
   431→    for pattern in patterns:
   432→        if pattern in clusters:
   433→            cluster = clusters[pattern]
   434→            # Filter to alive issues only — stale IDs should not count
   435→            ids = [
   436→                fid for fid in cluster.get("issue_ids", [])
   437→                if fid in issues and issues[fid].get("status") == "open"
   438→            ]
   439→            if len(ids) == 0:
   440→                print(colorize(
   441→                    f"\n  Cluster '{pattern}' is empty — add items before marking it done.\n",
   442→                    "yellow",
   443→                ))
   444→                print(colorize(

   456→    issues = state.get("issues", {})

   476→def _is_synthetic_id(fid: str) -> bool:
   477→    """Return True if the ID is a synthetic workflow/triage item, not a real issue."""
   478→    return fid.startswith("triage::") or fid.startswith("workflow::") or fid.startswith("subjective::")

   480→
   481→def _resolve_synthetic_ids(patterns: list[str]) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
   482→    """Separate synthetic IDs from real issue patterns.
   483→
   484→    Returns (synthetic_ids, remaining_patterns).
   485→    """
   486→    synthetic = [p for p in patterns if _is_synthetic_id(p)]
   487→    remaining = [p for p in patterns if not _is_synthetic_id(p)]
   488→    return synthetic, remaining

   491→def _blocked_triage_stages(plan: dict) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
   492→    """Return ``{stage_id: [blocked_by_ids]}`` for triage stages that can't run yet.
   493→
   494→    Uses the dependency graph and confirmed-stage metadata directly —
   495→    no state needed, no queue item construction.
   496→    """
   497→    order_set = set(plan.get("queue_order", []))
   498→    present = order_set & TRIAGE_IDS
   499→    if not present:
   500→        return {}
   501→
   502→    confirmed = set(plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {}).get("triage_stages", {}).keys())
   503→    stage_names = ("observe", "reflect", "organize", "enrich", "sense-check", "commit")
   504→
   505→    blocked: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
   506→    for sid, name in zip(TRIAGE_STAGE_IDS, stage_names, strict=False):
   507→        if sid not in present or name in confirmed:
   508→            continue
   509→        deps = TRIAGE_STAGE_DEPENDENCIES.get(name, set())
   510→        unmet = sorted(
   511→            f"triage::{dep}" for dep in deps
   512→            if f"triage::{dep}" in present and dep not in confirmed
   513→        )
   514→        if unmet:
   515→            blocked[sid] = unmet
   516→    return blocked
   517→

   519→def cmd_plan_resolve(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
   520→    """Mark issues as fixed — delegates to cmd_resolve for rich UX."""
   521→    patterns: list[str] = getattr(args, "patterns", [])

   810→def cmd_plan_scan_gate(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
   811→    """Check or skip the scan requirement for workflow items."""
   812→    skip = getattr(args, "skip", False)
   813→    note: str | None = getattr(args, "note", None)
   814→
   815→    plan = load_plan()
   816→    scan_count_at_start = plan.get("scan_count_at_plan_start")
   817→
   818→    if scan_count_at_start is None:
   819→        print(colorize("  No active plan cycle (plan_start_scores not seeded).", "dim"))
   820→        print(colorize("  Scan gate is not applicable — workflow items gate themselves.", "dim"))
   821→        return
   822→
   823→    resolved_state_path = state_path(args)
   824→    state_data = state_mod.load_state(resolved_state_path)
   825→    current_scan_count = int(state_data.get("scan_count", 0) or 0)
   826→    scan_ran = current_scan_count > scan_count_at_start
   827→    scan_skipped = plan.get("scan_gate_skipped", False)
   828→
   829→    if not skip:
   830→        # Status check
   831→        if scan_ran:
   832→            print(colorize("  Scan gate: PASSED", "green"))
   833→            print(colorize(
   834→                f"  Scans at cycle start: {scan_count_at_start}  "
   835→                f"Current: {current_scan_count}",
   836→                "dim",
   837→            ))
   838→        elif scan_skipped:
   839→            print(colorize("  Scan gate: SKIPPED (manually)", "yellow"))
   840→        else:
   841→            print(colorize("  Scan gate: BLOCKED", "red"))
   842→            print(colorize(
   843→                f"  Scans at cycle start: {scan_count_at_start}  "
   844→                f"Current: {current_scan_count}",
   845→                "dim",
   846→            ))
   847→            print(colorize("  Run: desloppify scan", "dim"))
   848→            print(colorize(
   849→                '  Or:  desloppify plan scan-gate --skip --note "reason"',
   850→                "dim",
   851→            ))
   852→        return
   853→
   854→    # --skip mode
   855→    if scan_ran:
   856→        print(colorize("  Scan already ran this cycle — no skip needed.", "green"))
   857→        return
   858→
   859→    if not note or len(note.strip()) < 50:
   860→        print(colorize(
   861→            "  --skip requires --note with at least 50 chars explaining why.",
   862→            "red",
   863→        ))
   864→        return
   865→
   866→    plan["scan_gate_skipped"] = True
   867→    append_log_entry(
   868→        plan, "scan_gate_skip",
   869→        actor="user",
   870→        note=note,
   871→        detail={
   872→            "scan_count_at_start": scan_count_at_start,
   873→            "current_scan_count": current_scan_count,
   874→        },
   875→    )
   876→    save_plan(plan)
   877→    print(colorize("  Scan requirement marked as satisfied (logged).", "yellow"))
   878→

   154→                stream.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
   155→            except (AttributeError, OSError):
   156→                logger.debug(
   157→                    "Skipping stream reconfigure for %s (not supported)",
   158→                    getattr(stream, "name", "<stream>"),
   159→                )
   160→
   161→    parser = create_parser()
   162→    args = parser.parse_args()
   163→    if not args.command:
   164→        parser.print_help()
   165→        return
   166→    if args.command == "help":
   167→        _handle_help_command(args, parser)
   168→        return
   169→
   170→    try:
   171→        with runtime_scope():
   172→            _resolve_default_path(args)
   173→            _load_shared_runtime(args)
   174→
   175→            handler = _resolve_handler(args.command)
   176→            handler(args)
   177→    except CommandError as exc:
   178→        print(colorize(f"  {exc.message}", "red"), file=sys.stderr)
   179→        sys.exit(exc.exit_code)

1→"""Stale-wontfix scan augmentation helpers."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→from pathlib import Path
     6→from typing import Any
     7→
     8→from desloppify import state as state_mod
     9→from desloppify.base.discovery.file_paths import resolve_path
    10→
    11→_STRUCTURAL_COMPLEXITY_GROWTH_THRESHOLD = 10
    12→_STRUCTURAL_LOC_GROWTH_THRESHOLD = 50
    13→
    14→
    15→def _in_scan_scope(filepath: str, scan_path: Path, *, project_root: Path) -> bool:
    16→    if scan_path.resolve() == project_root.resolve():
    17→        return True
    18→    full = Path(resolve_path(filepath))
    19→    root = scan_path.resolve()
    20→    return full == root or root in full.parents
    21→
    22→
    23→def _to_float(value: object) -> float | None:
    24→    if isinstance(value, bool):
    25→        return None
    26→    if isinstance(value, int | float):
    27→        return float(value)
    28→    if isinstance(value, str):
    29→        try:
    30→            return float(value)
    31→        except ValueError:
    32→            return None
    33→    return None
    34→
    35→
    36→def _structural_growth_details(
    37→    snapshot: dict[str, Any],
    38→    current: dict[str, Any],
    39→) -> dict[str, dict[str, float]]:
    40→    """Return structural drift details for wontfix issues."""
    41→    snapshot_detail = (
    42→        snapshot.get("detail", {}) if isinstance(snapshot.get("detail"), dict) else {}
    43→    )
    44→    current_detail = (
    45→        current.get("detail", {}) if isinstance(current.get("detail"), dict) else {}
    46→    )
    47→    drift: dict[str, dict[str, float]] = {}
    48→
    49→    old_complexity = _to_float(snapshot_detail.get("complexity_score"))
    50→    new_complexity = _to_float(current_detail.get("complexity_score"))
    51→    if (
    52→        old_complexity is not None
    53→        and new_complexity is not None
    54→        and new_complexity >= old_complexity + _STRUCTURAL_COMPLEXITY_GROWTH_THRESHOLD
    55→    ):
    56→        drift["complexity_score"] = {"from": old_complexity, "to": new_complexity}
    57→
    58→    old_loc = _to_float(snapshot_detail.get("loc"))
    59→    new_loc = _to_float(current_detail.get("loc"))
    60→    if (
    61→        old_loc is not None
    62→        and new_loc is not None
    63→        and new_loc >= old_loc + _STRUCTURAL_LOC_GROWTH_THRESHOLD
    64→    ):
    65→        drift["loc"] = {"from": old_loc, "to": new_loc}
    66→
    67→    return drift
    68→
    69→
    70→def _wontfix_staleness_reasons(
    71→    previous: dict[str, Any],
    72→    current: dict[str, Any],
    73→    *,
    74→    since_scan: int,
    75→    decay_scans: int,
    76→) -> tuple[list[str], dict[str, dict[str, float]]]:
    77→    """Determine why a wontfix issue is stale and compute structural drift."""
    78→    reasons: list[str] = []
    79→    if decay_scans > 0 and since_scan >= decay_scans:
    80→        reasons.append("scan_decay")
    81→
    82→    drift: dict[str, dict[str, float]] = {}
    83→    if previous.get("detector") == "structural":
    84→        snapshot = previous.get("wontfix_snapshot")
    85→        if isinstance(snapshot, dict):
    86→            drift = _structural_growth_details(snapshot, current)
    87→            if drift:
    88→                reasons.append("severity_drift")
    89→
    90→    return reasons, drift
    91→
    92→
    93→def _format_drift_summary(drift: dict[str, dict[str, float]]) -> str:
    94→    """Format structural drift metrics into a human-readable suffix."""
    95→    parts = []
    96→    if "complexity_score" in drift:
    97→        comp = drift["complexity_score"]
    98→        parts.append(f"complexity {comp['from']:.0f}->{comp['to']:.0f}")
    99→    if "loc" in drift:
   100→        loc = drift["loc"]
   101→        parts.append(f"loc {loc['from']:.0f}->{loc['to']:.0f}")
   102→    return f"; drift: {', '.join(parts)}" if parts else ""
   103→
   104→
   105→def _build_stale_wontfix_issue(
   106→    issue_id: str,
   107→    previous: dict[str, Any],
   108→    *,
   109→    reasons: list[str],
   110→    drift: dict[str, dict[str, float]],
   111→    since_scan: int,
   112→) -> dict[str, Any]:
   113→    """Construct a stale_wontfix issue from staleness metadata."""
   114→    tier = 4 if "severity_drift" in reasons else 3
   115→    confidence = "high" if "severity_drift" in reasons else "medium"
   116→    reason_text = " + ".join(reasons)
   117→    summary = (
   118→        f"Stale wontfix ({reason_text}): re-triage `{issue_id}` "
   119→        f"(last reviewed {since_scan} scans ago)"
   120→    )
   121→    summary += _format_drift_summary(drift)
   122→
   123→    return state_mod.make_issue(
   124→        "stale_wontfix",
   125→        previous.get("file", ""),
   126→        issue_id,
   127→        tier=tier,
   128→        confidence=confidence,
   129→        summary=summary,
   130→        detail={
   131→            "subtype": "stale_wontfix",
   132→            "original_issue_id": issue_id,
   133→            "original_detector": previous.get("detector"),
   134→            "reasons": reasons,
   135→            "scans_since_wontfix": since_scan,
   136→            "drift": drift,
   137→        },
   138→    )
   139→
   140→
   141→def augment_with_stale_wontfix_issues(
   142→    issues: list[dict[str, Any]],
   143→    *,
   144→    state: state_mod.StateModel,
   145→    scan_path: Path,
   146→    project_root: Path,
   147→    decay_scans: int,
   148→) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], int]:
   149→    """Append re-triage issues for stale or worsening wontfix debt."""
   150→    existing = state.get("issues", {})
   151→    if not isinstance(existing, dict):
   152→        return issues, 0
   153→
   154→    current_by_id = {
   155→        issue.get("id"): issue
   156→        for issue in issues
   157→        if issue.get("id")
   158→    }
   159→    augmented = list(issues)
   160→    monitored = 0
   161→
   162→    for issue_id, previous in existing.items():
   163→        if not isinstance(previous, dict):
   164→            continue
   165→        if previous.get("status") != "wontfix":
   166→            continue
   167→        if issue_id not in current_by_id:
   168→            continue
   169→        if not _in_scan_scope(
   170→            str(previous.get("file", "")),
   171→            scan_path,
   172→            project_root=project_root,
   173→        ):
   174→            continue
   175→
   176→        monitored += 1
   177→        scan_count = int(state.get("scan_count", 0) or 0)
   178→        since_scan = scan_count - int(previous.get("wontfix_scan_count", scan_count) or 0)
   179→        since_scan = max(since_scan, 0)
   180→
   181→        reasons, drift = _wontfix_staleness_reasons(
   182→            previous,
   183→            current_by_id[issue_id],
   184→            since_scan=since_scan,
   185→            decay_scans=decay_scans,
   186→        )
   187→        if not reasons:
   188→            continue
   189→
   190→        augmented.append(
   191→            _build_stale_wontfix_issue(
   192→                issue_id,
   193→                previous,
   194→                reasons=reasons,
   195→                drift=drift,
   196→                since_scan=since_scan,
   197→            )
   198→        )
   199→
   200→    return augmented, monitored
   201→
   202→
   203→__all__ = ["augment_with_stale_wontfix_issues"]
   204→

1→"""Pattern → issue-ID resolution for plan commands."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→from desloppify.engine.plan import PlanModel
     6→from desloppify.state import StateModel, match_issues
     7→
     8→
     9→def _append_unique(fid: str, seen: set[str], result: list[str]) -> None:
    10→    if fid in seen:
    11→        return
    12→    seen.add(fid)
    13→    result.append(fid)
    14→
    15→
    16→def _collect_plan_ids(plan: PlanModel | None) -> set[str]:
    17→    plan_ids: set[str] = set()
    18→    if plan is None:
    19→        return plan_ids
    20→    plan_ids.update(plan.get("queue_order", []))
    21→    plan_ids.update(plan.get("skipped", {}).keys())
    22→    for cluster in plan.get("clusters", {}).values():
    23→        plan_ids.update(cluster.get("issue_ids", []))
    24→    return plan_ids
    25→
    26→
    27→def resolve_ids_from_patterns(
    28→    state: StateModel,
    29→    patterns: list[str],
    30→    *,
    31→    plan: PlanModel | None = None,
    32→    status_filter: str = "open",
    33→) -> list[str]:
    34→    """Resolve one or more patterns to a deduplicated list of issue IDs.
    35→
    36→    When *plan* is provided, literal IDs that exist only in the plan
    37→    (e.g. ``subjective::*`` synthetic items) are included even if they
    38→    have no corresponding entry in ``state["issues"]``.
    39→    """
    40→    seen: set[str] = set()
    41→    result: list[str] = []
    42→    plan_ids = _collect_plan_ids(plan)
    43→
    44→    for pattern in patterns:
    45→        matches = match_issues(state, pattern, status_filter=status_filter)
    46→        if matches:
    47→            for issue in matches:
    48→                _append_unique(issue["id"], seen, result)
    49→            continue
    50→        if pattern in plan_ids:
    51→            # Literal plan ID (e.g. subjective::foo) not in state issues
    52→            _append_unique(pattern, seen, result)
    53→            continue
    54→        if plan is not None and pattern in plan.get("clusters", {}):
    55→            # Cluster name → expand to member IDs
    56→            for fid in plan["clusters"][pattern].get("issue_ids", []):
    57→                _append_unique(fid, seen, result)
    58→    return result
    59→
    60→
    61→__all__ = ["resolve_ids_from_patterns"]
    62→

    29→@dataclass(frozen=True)
    30→class QueueContext:
    31→    """Immutable snapshot of resolved queue parameters.
    32→
    33→    Built once via :func:`queue_context`, then threaded through
    34→    ``build_work_queue``, ``plan_aware_queue_breakdown``, and command
    35→    helpers so every call site agrees on plan, target, and policy.
    36→    """
    37→
    38→    plan: dict | None
    39→    target_strict: float
    40→    policy: SubjectiveVisibility
    41→
    42→
    43→def queue_context(
    44→    state: StateModel,

    47→    plan: dict | None | object = _PLAN_AUTO_LOAD,
    48→    target_strict: float | None = None,
    49→) -> QueueContext:
    50→    """Build a :class:`QueueContext` with all parameters resolved.
    51→
    52→    Resolution order:
    53→
    54→    1. **plan** — explicit value wins; sentinel ``_PLAN_AUTO_LOAD`` triggers
    55→       ``load_plan()`` (guarded by ``PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS``).
    56→    2. **target_strict** — explicit float wins; ``None`` reads from *config*
    57→       via ``target_strict_score_from_config``; final fallback is ``95.0``.
    58→    3. **policy** — ``compute_subjective_visibility(state, ...)`` with the
    59→       resolved plan and target_strict so every downstream consumer sees
    60→       the same objective-vs-subjective balance.
    61→    """
    62→    # --- resolve plan ---
    63→    if plan is _PLAN_AUTO_LOAD:
    64→        try:
    65→            resolved_plan: dict | None = plan_mod.load_plan()
    66→        except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS:
    67→            resolved_plan = None
    68→    else:
    69→        resolved_plan = plan  # type: ignore[assignment]
    70→
    71→    # --- resolve target_strict ---
    72→    if target_strict is not None:
    73→        resolved_target = target_strict
    74→    elif config is not None:
    75→        resolved_target = target_strict_score_from_config(config)
    76→    else:
    77→        resolved_target = DEFAULT_TARGET_STRICT_SCORE
    78→
    79→    # --- resolve policy ---
    80→    resolved_policy = compute_subjective_visibility(
    81→        state,
    82→        target_strict=resolved_target,
    83→        plan=resolved_plan,
    84→    )
    85→
    86→    return QueueContext(

    88→        target_strict=resolved_target,
    89→        policy=resolved_policy,

   148→def _build_tree(files: list[dict], dep_graph: dict, issues_by_file: dict) -> dict:

   175→            "issues_total": len(file_issues),

   227→def _write_visualization_output(output: Path, html: str) -> OutputResult:
   228→    """Write visualization HTML to disk using the shared output-result contract."""
   229→    try:
   230→        safe_write_text(output, html)
   231→    except OSError as exc:
   232→        return OutputResult(
   233→            ok=False,
   234→            status="error",
   235→            message=str(exc),
   236→            error_kind="visualization_write_error",
   237→        )
   238→    return OutputResult(ok=True, status="written", message=f"wrote {output}")
   239→
   240→
   241→def generate_visualization(
   242→    path: Path, state: dict | None = None, output: Path | None = None, lang=None
   243→) -> tuple[str, OutputResult]:
   244→    """Generate an HTML treemap visualization and explicit output result."""
   245→    try:
   246→        files = _collect_file_data(path, lang)
   247→        dep_graph = _build_dep_graph_for_path(path, lang)
   248→        issues_by_file = _issues_by_file(state)
   249→        tree = _build_tree(files, dep_graph, issues_by_file)
   250→        # Escape </ to prevent </script> in filenames from breaking HTML
   251→        tree_json = json.dumps(tree).replace("</", r"<\/")
   252→
   253→        # Stats for header
   254→        total_files = len(files)
   255→        total_loc = sum(f["loc"] for f in files)
   256→        total_issues = sum(len(v) for v in issues_by_file.values())
   257→        open_issues = sum(
   258→            1 for fs in issues_by_file.values() for f in fs if f.get("status") == "open"
   259→        )
   260→        if state:
   261→            scores = score_snapshot(state)
   262→            overall_score = scores.overall
   263→            objective_score = scores.objective
   264→            strict_score = scores.strict
   265→        else:
   266→            overall_score = objective_score = strict_score = None
   267→
   268→        def _fmt_viz_score(value):
   269→            return f"{value:.1f}" if isinstance(value, int | float) else "N/A"
   270→
   271→        replacements = {
   272→            "__D3_CDN_URL__": D3_CDN_URL,
   273→            "__TREE_DATA__": tree_json,
   274→            "__TOTAL_FILES__": str(total_files),
   275→            "__TOTAL_LOC__": f"{total_loc:,}",
   276→            "__TOTAL_ISSUES__": str(total_issues),
   277→            "__OPEN_ISSUES__": str(open_issues),
   278→            "__OVERALL_SCORE__": _fmt_viz_score(overall_score),
   279→            "__OBJECTIVE_SCORE__": _fmt_viz_score(objective_score),
   280→            "__STRICT_SCORE__": _fmt_viz_score(strict_score),
   281→        }
   282→        html = _get_html_template()
   283→        for placeholder, value in replacements.items():
   284→            html = html.replace(placeholder, value)
   285→    except OSError as exc:
   286→        return "", OutputResult(
   287→            ok=False,
   288→            status="error",
   289→            message=str(exc),
   290→            error_kind="visualization_generation_error",
   291→        )
   292→
   293→    if output:
   294→        write_result = _write_visualization_output(output, html)
   295→        if not write_result.ok:
   296→            message = write_result.message or "unknown write failure"
   297→            print_write_error(output, OSError(message), label="visualization")
   298→            return html, write_result
   299→        return html, write_result
   300→
   301→    return html, OutputResult(
   302→        ok=True,
   303→        status="not_requested",
   304→        message="visualization generated in memory only",
   305→    )
   306→
   307→
   308→def cmd_viz(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
   309→    """Generate HTML treemap visualization."""
   310→    path, lang, state = load_cmd_context(args)
   311→    output = Path(getattr(args, "output", None) or ".desloppify/treemap.html")
   312→    print(colorize("Collecting file data and building dependency graph...", "dim"))
   313→    _, output_result = generate_visualization(path, state, output, lang=lang)
   314→    if output_result.status != "written":
   315→        message = output_result.message or "unknown write failure"
   316→        print(
   317→            colorize(
   318→                f"\nVisualization write failed ({output_result.status}): {output} ({message})",
   319→                "red",
   320→            ),
   321→            file=sys.stderr,
   322→        )
   323→        raise SystemExit(1)
   324→    print(colorize(f"\nTreemap written to {output}", "green"))
   325→    print(colorize(f"Open in browser: file://{output.resolve()}", "dim"))
   326→
   327→@dataclass
   328→class TreeTextOptions:
   329→    """Text tree rendering options."""
   330→    max_depth: int = 2
   331→    focus: str | None = None
   332→    min_loc: int = 0
   333→    sort_by: str = "loc"
   334→    detail: bool = False
   335→
   336→
   337→def generate_tree_text(
   338→    path: Path,
   339→    state: dict | None = None,
   340→    options: TreeTextOptions | None = None,
   341→    *,
   342→    lang=None,
   343→) -> str:
   344→    """Generate text-based annotated tree of the codebase."""
   345→    resolved_options = options or TreeTextOptions()
   346→    files = _collect_file_data(path, lang)
   347→    dep_graph = _build_dep_graph_for_path(path, lang)
   348→    tree = _build_tree(files, dep_graph, _issues_by_file(state))
   349→
   350→    root = tree
   351→    if resolved_options.focus:
   352→        parts = resolved_options.focus.strip("/").split("/")
   353→        if parts and parts[0] == "src":
   354→            parts = parts[1:]
   355→        for part in parts:
   356→            found = None
   357→            for child in root.get("children", []):
   358→                if child["name"] == part:
   359→                    found = child
   360→                    break
   361→            if found is None:
   362→                return f"Directory not found: {resolved_options.focus}"
   363→            root = found
   364→
   365→    lines = render_tree_lines(
   366→        root,
   367→        max_depth=resolved_options.max_depth,
   368→        min_loc=resolved_options.min_loc,
   369→        sort_by=resolved_options.sort_by,
   370→        detail=resolved_options.detail,
   371→    )
   372→    return "\n".join(lines)
   373→
   374→
   375→def cmd_tree(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
   376→    """Print annotated codebase tree to terminal."""
   377→    path, lang, state = load_cmd_context(args)
   378→    print(
   379→        generate_tree_text(
   380→            path,
   381→            state,
   382→            options=TreeTextOptions(
   383→                max_depth=getattr(args, "depth", 2),
   384→                focus=getattr(args, "focus", None),
   385→                min_loc=getattr(args, "min_loc", 0),
   386→                sort_by=getattr(args, "sort", "loc"),
   387→                detail=getattr(args, "detail", False),
   388→            ),
   389→            lang=lang,
   390→        )
   391→    )
   392→
   393→
   394→def _get_html_template() -> str:
   395→    """Read the HTML treemap template from the external file."""
   396→    return (Path(__file__).parent / "_viz_template.html").read_text()
   397→

   107→def _seed_plan_start_scores(plan: dict[str, object], state: state_mod.StateModel) -> bool:
   108→    """Set plan_start_scores when beginning a new queue cycle."""
   109→    existing = plan.get("plan_start_scores")
   110→    if existing and not isinstance(existing, dict):
   111→        return False
   112→    # Seed when empty OR when it's the reset sentinel ({"reset": True})
   113→    if existing and not existing.get("reset"):
   114→        return False
   115→    scores = state_mod.score_snapshot(state)
   116→    if scores.strict is None:
   117→        return False
   118→    plan["plan_start_scores"] = {
   119→        "strict": scores.strict,
   120→        "overall": scores.overall,
   121→        "objective": scores.objective,
   122→        "verified": scores.verified,
   123→    }
   124→    # Record scan count at cycle start so gates can detect whether a new scan ran
   125→    plan["scan_count_at_plan_start"] = int(state.get("scan_count", 0) or 0)
   126→    return True

   129→def _clear_plan_start_scores_if_queue_empty(

   133→    if not plan.get("plan_start_scores"):
   134→        return False
   135→
   136→    try:
   137→        from desloppify.app.commands.helpers.queue_progress import (
   138→            ScoreDisplayMode,
   139→            plan_aware_queue_breakdown,
   140→            score_display_mode,
   141→        )
   142→
   143→        breakdown = plan_aware_queue_breakdown(state, plan)
   144→        frozen_strict = plan.get("plan_start_scores", {}).get("strict")
   145→        queue_empty = score_display_mode(breakdown, frozen_strict) is not ScoreDisplayMode.FROZEN
   146→    except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS as exc:
   147→        log_best_effort_failure(logger, "run post-scan plan reconciliation", exc)
   148→        return False
   149→    if not queue_empty:
   150→        return False
   151→    state["_plan_start_scores_for_reveal"] = dict(plan["plan_start_scores"])
   152→    plan["plan_start_scores"] = {}
   153→    return True

   289→    # Only clear scores that existed before this reconcile pass —

   291→    cleared = _clear_plan_start_scores_if_queue_empty(state, plan)
   292→    if cleared:

   294→    return cleared

   297→def reconcile_plan_post_scan(runtime: Any) -> None:
   298→    """Reconcile plan queue metadata and stale subjective review dimensions."""
   299→    plan_path = runtime.state_path.parent / "plan.json" if runtime.state_path else None
   300→    try:
   301→        plan = load_plan(plan_path)
   302→    except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS as exc:
   303→        logger.warning("Plan reconciliation skipped (load failed): %s", exc)
   304→        return
   305→    dirty = False
   306→
   307→    if _apply_plan_reconciliation(plan, runtime.state, reconcile_plan_after_scan):
   308→        dirty = True
   309→
   310→    if _sync_unscored_and_log(plan, runtime.state):
   311→        dirty = True
   312→
   313→    target_strict, policy, cycle_just_completed = _subjective_policy_context(
   314→        runtime,
   315→        plan,
   316→    )
   317→    if _sync_stale_and_log(
   318→        plan,
   319→        runtime.state,
   320→        policy=policy,
   321→        cycle_just_completed=cycle_just_completed,
   322→    ):
   323→        dirty = True
   324→
   325→    if _sync_auto_clusters_and_log(
   326→        plan,
   327→        runtime.state,
   328→        target_strict=target_strict,
   329→        policy=policy,
   330→        cycle_just_completed=cycle_just_completed,
   331→    ):
   332→        dirty = True
   333→
   334→    if _sync_communicate_score_and_log(plan, runtime.state, policy=policy):
   335→        dirty = True
   336→    if _sync_create_plan_and_log(plan, runtime.state, policy=policy):
   337→        dirty = True
   338→    if _sync_triage_and_log(plan, runtime.state):
   339→        dirty = True
   340→    if _sync_plan_start_scores_and_log(plan, runtime.state):
   341→        dirty = True
   342→
   343→    if dirty:
   344→        try:
   345→            save_plan(plan, plan_path)
   346→        except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS as exc:
   347→            logger.warning("Plan reconciliation save failed: %s", exc)
   348→

    58→def _resolve_env_int(name: str, default: int, *, min_value: int = 1) -> int:

   125→def _build_roslyn_command(roslyn_cmd: str, path: Path) -> list[str] | None:
   126→    """Convert command template to argv safely without shell execution."""
   127→    split_posix = os.name != "nt"
   128→    try:
   129→        if "{path}" in roslyn_cmd:
   130→            expanded = roslyn_cmd.replace("{path}", str(path))
   131→            argv = shlex.split(expanded, posix=split_posix)
   132→        else:
   133→            argv = shlex.split(roslyn_cmd, posix=split_posix)
   134→            argv.append(str(path))
   135→    except ValueError:
   136→        return None
   137→    return argv or None

   140→def _build_dep_graph_roslyn(
   141→    path: Path, roslyn_cmd: str | None = None
   142→) -> dict[str, dict] | None:
   143→    """Try optional Roslyn-backed graph command, return None on fallback."""
   144→    resolved_roslyn_cmd = (roslyn_cmd or "").strip()
   145→    if not resolved_roslyn_cmd:
   146→        resolved_roslyn_cmd = os.environ.get("DESLOPPIFY_CSHARP_ROSLYN_CMD", "").strip()
   147→    roslyn_cmd = resolved_roslyn_cmd
   148→    if not roslyn_cmd:
   149→        return None
   150→
   151→    cmd = _build_roslyn_command(roslyn_cmd, path)
   152→    if not cmd:
   153→        return None
   154→    timeout_seconds = _resolve_env_int(
   155→        "DESLOPPIFY_CSHARP_ROSLYN_TIMEOUT_SECONDS",
   156→        _DEFAULT_ROSLYN_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
   157→    )
   158→    max_output_bytes = _resolve_env_int(
   159→        "DESLOPPIFY_CSHARP_ROSLYN_MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES",
   160→        _DEFAULT_ROSLYN_MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES,
   161→    )
   162→    try:
   163→        proc = subprocess.run(
   164→            cmd,
   165→            shell=False,
   166→            check=False,
   167→            capture_output=True,
   168→            text=False,
   169→            timeout=timeout_seconds,
   170→        )
   171→    except (OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
   172→        return None
   173→    if proc.returncode != 0:
   174→        return None
   175→    stdout_bytes = proc.stdout or b""
   176→    if len(stdout_bytes) > max_output_bytes:

   213→    file_to_namespace: dict[str, str | None] = {}
   214→    file_to_usings: dict[str, set[str]] = {}

   216→    for filepath in cs_files:

   227→    # Add project root namespaces as fallback namespace owners.

   230→        if ns and source not in namespace_to_files[ns]:
   231→            namespace_to_files[ns].add(source)

   233→    project_to_namespaces: dict[Path, set[str]] = defaultdict(set)
   234→    for source, ns in file_to_namespace.items():

   237→        proj = file_to_project.get(source)
   238→        if proj is not None:

    36→def _run_stamp() -> str:
    37→    return datetime.now(UTC).strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
    38→
    39→
    40→def _parse_only_stages(raw: str | None) -> list[str]:
    41→    """Parse --only-stages comma-separated string into validated stage list."""
    42→    if not raw:
    43→        return list(_STAGES)
    44→    stages = [s.strip().lower() for s in raw.split(",") if s.strip()]
    45→    for s in stages:
    46→        if s not in _STAGES:
    47→            raise ValueError(f"Unknown stage: {s!r}. Valid: {', '.join(_STAGES)}")
    48→    return stages
    49→

    51→def _ensure_triage_started(
    52→    plan: dict,
    53→    services: TriageServices,
    54→) -> dict:
    55→    """Auto-start triage if not started. Returns updated plan."""
    56→    if not has_triage_in_queue(plan):
    57→        inject_triage_stages(plan)
    58→        meta = plan.setdefault("epic_triage_meta", {})
    59→        meta.setdefault("triage_stages", {})
    60→        services.save_plan(plan)
    61→        print(colorize("  Planning mode auto-started.", "cyan"))
    62→    return plan
    63→

    65→def do_run_triage_stages(
    66→    args: argparse.Namespace,
    67→    *,
    68→    services: TriageServices | None = None,
    69→) -> None:
    70→    """Run triage stages via the selected runner."""
    71→    runner = str(getattr(args, "runner", "codex")).strip().lower()
    72→    if runner == "claude":
    73→        _run_claude_orchestrator(args, services=services)
    74→    elif runner == "codex":
    75→        _run_codex_pipeline(args, services=services)
    76→    else:
    77→        print(colorize(f"  Unknown runner: {runner}. Use 'codex' or 'claude'.", "red"))

    87→    repo_root = get_project_root()
    88→    plan = resolved_services.load_plan()
    89→    _ensure_triage_started(plan, resolved_services)
    90→
    91→    print(colorize("\n  Claude triage orchestrator mode.", "bold"))
    92→    print(colorize("  " + "─" * 60, "dim"))
    93→    print(colorize(
    94→        "  You are the orchestrator. For each stage, launch a subagent.\n",
    95→        "cyan",
    96→    ))
    97→    print("  For each stage (observe → reflect → organize → enrich → sense-check):\n")
    98→    print("    1. Get the prompt:")
    99→    print("       desloppify plan triage --stage-prompt <stage>\n")
   100→    print("    2. Launch a subagent (Agent tool) with that prompt.\n")
   101→    print("    3. Verify the stage was recorded:")
   102→    print("       desloppify plan triage\n")
   103→    print("    4. Confirm:")
